{"action": "write", "path": "intervals.py", "content": "def merge(intervals):
    """Merge overlapping or touching [start, end] intervals.

    Returns a new list of disjoint intervals sorted by start.
    The input list and its intervals are not modified.
    """
    if not intervals:
        return []

    ordered = sorted((list(iv) for iv in intervals), key=lambda iv: (iv[0], iv[1]))

    merged = [ordered[0]]
    for start, end in ordered[1:]:
        last = merged[-1]
        if start <= last[1]:
            if end > last[1]:
                last[1] = end
        else:
            merged.append([start, end])

    return merged


if __name__ == "__main__":
    cases = [
        ([[1, 3], [2, 6], [8, 10], [15, 18]], [[1, 6], [8, 10], [15, 18]]),
        ([[1, 4], [4, 5]], [[1, 5]]),
        ([[5, 7], [1, 2], [2, 3], [3, 5]], [[1, 5], [5, 7]]),
        ([[1, 4], [0, 4]], [[0, 4]]),

        ([[1, 1], [1, 1], [2, 2]], [[1, 1], [2, 2]]),
        ([], []),
        ([[7, 9]], [[7, 9]]),
    ]
    for given, expected in cases:
        original = [list(iv) for iv in given]
        got = merge(given)
        assert got == expected, (given, got, expected)
        assert given == original, "input mutated: %r" % (given,)
    print("all tests passed")
